errors.text_span: Общият брой на категориите е шест.
errors.evidence: The chart shows seven categories (14-17, 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, 65+), not six.
The largest sector, with 20%, corresponds to the age group "25-34", not "65+" which is 14%.
The largest sector ("25-34") is grey. The "65+" sector is dark blue. No sector is white.

errors.text_span: Следващ по размер е секторът "14-17" с жълт цвят, представляващ приблизително 17%.
errors.evidence: This sentence incorrectly maps the category, color, and value. The second largest sector (17%) is "35-44" and is yellow. The "14-17" sector is only 5% and is dark blue.

errors.text_span: Секторът "18-24" с оранжев цвят е около 16%.
errors.evidence: The sector for the age group "18-24" is 13%, not 16%.

errors.text_span: Следват секторите "25-34" (син), "35-44" (зелен) и "45-54" (тъмно син), които съответно заемат около 15%, 13% и 14% от цялото.
errors.evidence: This entire sentence is a series of incorrect mappings. For example, "25-34" is grey and 20% (not blue and 15%); "35-44" is yellow and 17% (not green and 13%); "45-54" is light blue and 16% (not dark blue and 14%).

errors.text_span: Всяка секция има етикет, който показва възрастовата група
errors.evidence: The age group labels are located in the legend below the chart, not on the pie slices themselves. The slices only contain percentage labels.

errors.text_span: техните размери изглеждат подредени по намаляващ порядък
errors.evidence: The chart segments are not ordered by size. The values, going clockwise, are 5%, 13%, 20%, 17%, 16%, 15%, 14%, which is not a decreasing order.
